g.text: 150 stores · ~30 cameras each · 4,500+ concurrent streams · sub-second inference at the edge
camera → decode → queue → detect → track → rule → event → GKE → operator acts → label → retrain
edge pipeline — decode never touches the CPU
an event needs a zone, dwell time and a
what crosses is ~2 KB of JSON
and one 6 s clip, only when
is in the store and not
event + clip · HTTPS, retried by the appliance
stateless cluster, state pushed outside it
not CPU. the slow part is the LLM
call, and a pod pegged at 8% CPU
150 stores do not fire evenly — closing time spikes.
the cluster is cattle. the appliances are not — see the model loop.
only HIGH severity reaches a person
it is already a row in Postgres,
and it stays there for the shift digest —
which is the only reason the operator
still trusts the siren when it does fire.
loss numbers, not a benchmark set.
the operator is the labeller — that is the whole data strategy
an engine is built per GPU model.
there is no single binary that ships
to all 150 stores — this cost us weeks
deciding what to retrain ON is not —
the operator clicks are the only
ground truth anyone ever gave us.
Rafael De Santis · rasantis.github.io · built and operated solo, edge to cloud
